description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Percentage responsible for validating percentage values as per the CSS specification, within the HTML Purifier library. It ensures CSS percentage values (like '50%') are correctly validated, possibly deferring number validation to another class.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Percentage
classes.description: A class for validating CSS percentage values, such as '50%', ensuring correct format and value constraints as per the CSS specification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the percentage validator, optionally disallowing negative values by instantiating the number validation component accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that a string is a proper CSS percentage value, e.g., '50%', by checking its syntax and value using delegated number validation.
